front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《36》

zh: 竹籬之外，還有草徑池塘
防風林之外，還有海浪漁船
野薑花說，還有，夕陽山外山
en: Beyond the bamboo fence, there is still a grassy path and a pond
Beyond the windbreak forest, there are also waves and fishing boats
The wild ginger lily says, and there is more—sunset beyond mountain beyond mountain

points.zh:
林亨泰的詩: 《 風景No.2 》
防風林   的
外邊   還有
防風林   的
外邊   還有
防風林   的
外邊   還有
然而海   以及波的羅列
然而海   以及波的羅列
《 風景No. 2 》 是林亨泰 ( l924--， 彰化北斗人，笠詩刊創始人之一 )  最負盛名的代表詩作。這詩在形式上致力於現代主義前衛技巧的實驗，是以文字的圖象排列來表現的「圖象詩」或「符號詩」。此詩是借詩行或意象語句之重複或平行排列，造成無限的空間疊景， 意象的綿延不絕。「風景No.2」用字樸實，意象單純，但透過詩人特殊的句型處理，詩行排列後，簡單的兩組意象 : 防風林與海，竟然產生了詩的視覺，音樂，想像和速度的美感，表現了微妙的現代知性的意象美，這也是此詩經久被引述議論的緣由。
points.en:
Lin Heng-tai's poem, 'Scenery No. 2'
The windbreak forest
beyond it
another windbreak forest
beyond it
another windbreak forest
beyond it
and yet the sea and the rows of waves
and yet the sea and the rows of waves
'Scenery No. 2' is the most celebrated representative poem of Lin Heng-tai (b. 1924, from Beidou, Changhua, one of the founders of Li Poetry Journal). Formally, this poem strives for an avant-garde modernist technique, being a "visual poem" or "symbolic poem" expressed through the graphic arrangement of text. The poem uses repeated or parallel arrangements of lines or imagery to create an endless layering of space, an unbroken continuation of imagery. 'Scenery No. 2' uses plain language and simple imagery, but through the poet's distinctive handling of sentence patterns and the arrangement of the lines, the two simple images — windbreak forest and sea — produce a beauty of visual, musical, imaginative, and kinetic sense in poetry, expressing a subtle, modern, intellectual beauty of imagery — this is also why this poem has been so enduringly cited and discussed.

en: Listening to cicadas in summer
Until after autumn, when no cicadas remain
Watching the falling leaves, sitting still as in Zen
Now, you realize
There is something more bewildered than dusk
Tears that linger still, unwilling to leave
Greece, broken walls and shattered columns
Picking up a colored stone
Give it back to Nüwa, to mend the sky

points.zh:
希臘神話，普羅米修斯創造了人; 舊約聖經，上帝創造了亞當與夏娃; 在中國，龍尾人身的女媧創造了蒼生，是大地之母。
中國神話，「女媧補天」的神話記載於西漢劉安所著的《淮南子‧覽冥訓》。故事講說遠古之時，突發天崩地裂，天的紛紛塌下來；天地之間時而烈火熊熊，時而傾盆大雨，地面一片火海。後得女媧煉得五色石，以補蒼天，解救黎民百姓於苦難之中。後人用「女媧補天」讚揚修天造地的氣魄及拯救衆生的慈悲心懷。
points.en:
In Greek mythology, Prometheus created humankind; in the Old Testament, God created Adam and Eve; in China, Nüwa, dragon-tailed and human-bodied, created all living beings and is the mother of the earth.
In Chinese mythology, the story of "Nüwa Mending the Sky" is recorded in the "Lanming Xun" chapter of the Huainanzi, written by Liu An of the Western Han dynasty. The story tells that in ancient times, the sky suddenly collapsed and the earth split apart; between heaven and earth, raging fires blazed and torrential rains poured down, and the ground became a sea of fire. Nüwa then refined five-colored stones to mend the heavens, delivering the common people from their suffering. Later generations use the phrase "Nüwa mending the sky" to praise the grand resolve to repair heaven and earth and the compassionate heart that saves all living beings.

en: Wooden Fish Sound Sky
Flower Picking Empty Hands
Reincarnation of Dream Void
Having crossed the Chu River, storm clouds begin to gather
Dusk, sweeping slowly in
A soldier, playing out the remains of the chess game

points.en: Chinese chess terminology: "Endgame — pawn defeats cannon."

zh: “  To be or not to be that is the question  ”是劇中, 哈姆雷特獨白的名言。
en: "To be or not to be, that is the question" is the famous line from Hamlet's soliloquy in the play.

points.zh:
哈姆雷特劇情大要:
英明果斷、智勇雙全的王子 (哈姆雷特) , 從其父親的鬼魂口中得知他叔父的惡行：謀害父親、篡奪王位、奸騙母后而成其王妃。王子於不動聲色中，調查一切屬實，不計己身榮辱、裝瘋扮傻，伺機為父報仇。最後，身入險境，試圖在叔父安排的一場比劍陰謀中，舉發其罪行。其目的雖然達成，卻也陰錯陽差，於比劍當場中毒身亡。劇中人物怯懦、狡詐有之，果決、機智有之，善與惡明確對立，但均遭命運之神無情擺弄，無可奈何。
( 取自網路 )
莎士比亞的四大悲劇作品《哈姆雷特》、《李爾王》、《馬克白》和《奧賽羅》。
points.en:
Summary of the plot of Hamlet:
The wise and resolute prince Hamlet, brave and clever, learns from his father's ghost of his uncle's wrongdoing — murdering his father, usurping the throne, and deceiving his mother into becoming his queen. Without revealing his intentions, the prince investigates and confirms everything is true. Disregarding his own honor or disgrace, he feigns madness, waiting for the chance to avenge his father. In the end, he places himself in danger, attempting to expose his uncle's crime during a fencing match arranged as a plot against him. Although he achieves his goal, through a twist of fate he is poisoned and dies during the very duel.
(Taken from the internet)
Shakespeare's four great tragedies: Hamlet, King Lear, Macbeth, and Othello.

en: Wild geese fly south
From here, a thousand miles into the unknown
The only choice, direction
May's tung blossoms
Not knowing the person has already gone
Falling to cover the little path

points.zh:
梁園日暮亂飛鴉，極目䔥條三兩家。
庭樹不知人已去，春來還發舊時花。
--唐。岑參《山房春事》
points.en:
At dusk over Liang Garden, crows fly in disorder; as far as the eye can see, only a few desolate houses remain.
The courtyard trees do not know that their master is gone, and in spring still bloom with flowers of old.
-- Tang dynasty. Cen Shen, 'Spring Affairs at the Mountain Lodge'

en: The west wind rises
The Buddha whispers with the wildflowers
Saying, I'll come see you again next year

points.zh:
《 西風的話 》
作詞：廖輔淑   作曲：黃自 

去年我回來 你們剛穿新棉袍
今年我來看你們 你們變胖又變高
你們可曾記得 池裡荷花變蓮蓬
花開不愁沒有顏色 
我把樹葉都染紅
points.en:
"Words of the West Wind"
Lyrics: Liao Fu-shu; Music: Huang Tzu

Last year when I returned, you had just put on new cotton robes
This year when I come to see you, you have grown taller and stronger
Do you still remember how the lotus flowers in the pond turned into seed pods?
The flowers need not worry about lacking color --
I am the one who dyes the leaves red
